description: Reads a Microsoft Project, Primavera or ProjectLibre file (.mpp, .mpx, .xml MSPDI, .xer, .pod) and reports what an import would contain: number of tasks, dependencies, resources and calendars, project dates, first tasks and warnings. It does not create anything. To actually import the file use planitude_import_file. Read-only.

contentBase64.description: File content encoded in base64. Requires filename.

tz.description: Time zone for the times in the file (IANA, e.g. Europe/Rome). Default UTC.

workspaceId.description: Target workspace. Omitted = the personal workspace.

name: planitude_preview_import
title: Preview a project file import
